phase: 96 existing development schedules x two independent purchase seeds = 192. Known 12 citizens and four known policy mechanisms. Fixed v23 plans; no new planner calls or holdout claims.
primary: Every registered response retained. >=95% raw financial/quote contract pass, zero request failures, no invented usable funds. Review purchase reasons separately for unsupported needs. No failed response zero filling. Each policy contrast requires a complete valid paired matrix.
selection: Generic asset_transaction_v1 frozen; no selection by consumption effect sign or size, no desired effect targets in model inputs.
conditions: Hypothetical item prices fixed before output; not inferred from individual daily expenditure.
Hypothetical merchant participation and personal eligibility; exact age/card history not observed.
Explicit zero is allowed. Free schedule activities cannot be routed to a merchant.
Own cash, grant balance and prepaid asset acquisition separate; future rebate not current money.
Fixed one-day upstream schedules, missing inventory/needs/income path; this is not total daily demand validation.
Two purchase seeds share same paired planner draws; not independent whole-engine rollouts.
interpretation: Report all paired nominal consumption, funding and asset acquisition contrasts regardless of direction. These are conditional synthetic scenario outputs, never comparisons to historical empirical magnitudes or significance.
